post.description: Signs in a user with an alias and password. Returns the user and a new auth token.
Signs out the user and invalidates the given auth token.
Creates a new user account from first name, last name, alias, password, and profile image. Returns the user and a new auth token.

post.summary: Get a page of feed statuses
post.description: Returns a paginated list of statuses posted by the users the given user follows, plus whether more pages exist. Requires an auth token.
Makes the signed-in user follow the given user. Returns the updated follower and followee counts. Requires an auth token.
Returns the number of users the given user follows. Requires an auth token.
Returns a paginated list of the users the given user follows, plus whether more pages exist. Requires an auth token.
Returns the number of followers the given user has. Requires an auth token.
Returns a paginated list of the users who follow the given user, plus whether more pages exist. Requires an auth token.
Returns whether one user follows another user. Requires an auth token.
Posts a new status for the signed-in user. Requires an auth token.

post.summary: Get a page of story statuses
post.description: Returns a paginated list of statuses posted by the given user, plus whether more pages exist. Requires an auth token.
Makes the signed-in user stop following the given user. Returns the updated follower and followee counts. Requires an auth token.
Returns the user with the given alias. Requires an auth token.
